messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: metering.delta_count anomaly detected in wavefront cluster — token-count delta > 25% vs baseline across ingest-*-prod. Auto-escalation to oncall.
priya shah: oncall here, ack. will take lead. first step: confirm customer-facing impact.
mike chan: pulling ingestion metrics and consumer lag now — running `kafka-consumer-groups --describe --group usage-ingest-prod`.
jordan lee: consumer lag on partition set A: ~120k messages, backlog started ~07:09 UTC, spike aligns with a surge of short requests from edge-20.
sara nguyen: billing dashboard telemetry shows provisional overage flags being queued; not yet issued invoices but email-notify job kicked off at 07:12 UTC for a subset. tagging @billing-team-bot to verify.
billing-team-bot: Heads up: 42 accounts currently in provisional overage state (flagged) between 07:11-07:15 UTC. Notifications queued but held in retry queue. No charges posted yet.
priya shah: okay — mitigation plan: (1) pause billing notifications, (2) prevent provisional flags from becoming persistent until reconciliation, (3) reduce ingestion parallelism to let consumer catch up.
mike chan: running restart on usage-ingest consumer group to rebalance and pick up offsets. cmd: 
```
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deployment/usage-ingest-consumer
kubectl logs -f deploy/usage-ingest-consumer -c consumer | grep "offset commit" --line-buffered
```
logs: `Committed offset 23456789 for partition 12` — consumers rebalanced at 07:18 UTC.
jordan lee: spotted repeated error in aggregator logs: `KVCache miss overflow` around 07:08-07:13. suspect a cache eviction regression from last week's runtime tweak.
sara nguyen: billing queue snapshot (quick): `redis://billing-queue/notifications`: 120 entries, most are for small deltas. I can push cancel for notify job: `/billing disable-notify --reason "incidents/2049123456 temporary hold"`.
priya shah: do it. also run a scoped recon query to compute authoritative token counts so we can rollback flags if needed. SQL to run (recon service):
```
-- recon token totals per account for window
SELECT account_id, SUM(tokens) AS total_tokens
FROM usage_events
WHERE ts >= '2024-11-01T07:00:00Z' AND ts < '2024-11-01T07:20:00Z'
GROUP BY account_id
HAVING SUM(tokens) > 0
ORDER BY total_tokens DESC
LIMIT 500;
```
mike chan: recon started — expected runtime ~ 3m for the 20m window. also checking ingress rate from edge-20: 600 rps sustained for 3m then dropped.
jordan lee: found a race in KVCache refresh logic that could double-count edge short requests when cache eviction coincides with batching window. creating a quick patch branch: `fix/kvcache-eviction-atomic`
sara nguyen: recon results: top 10 accounts show 18% higher tokens vs pre-incident baseline — looks consistent with double-count on aggregator.
priya shah: customer impact assessment: provisional overage flags reached 42 accounts but no billing posted. estimated exposure if unmitigated: ~$1.2K for this window. action: (A) cancel all queued notifications (done), (B) rollback provisional flags that match recon mismatch (in progress), (C) schedule immediate hotfix to aggregator (jordan).
jordan lee: hotfix ready, smoke-tested on staging. patch apply plan: canary to 1 pod -> monitor 5m -> rollout. patch deploy command: `kubectl -n prod set image deploy/aggregator aggregator=redwood/aggregator:kvfix-2049`
mike chan: canary started at 07:26 UTC, canary pod healthy, no KVCache miss errors in canary logs so far.
ops-bot: Incident timeline note created in incident manager: https://incidents.internal/2049123456 — handoff window scheduled at 07:40 UTC.
priya shah: handoff to night-ops in 14m. final checks: billing queue drained to 12 entries (we retained 12 for manual review), recon-run produced canonical counts; will submit rollback job to unset provisional flags for matching account_ids.
sara nguyen: rollback job SQL snippet ready: `UPDATE billing_flags SET status='cleared' WHERE provisional=true AND account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM recon_run_2049123456);` — queued as job `billing-recon-rollback-2049123456`.
jordan lee: rolling out full patch now after 5m successful canary. rollout progress: 3/3 pods updated, no errors.
priya shah: monitoring window 15m after full rollout. if stable, we'll close pager and open a postmortem. please add any missed notes to the incident doc.
mike chan: follow-up: add metric alert for KVCache eviction spikes and a circuit-breaker to prevent double-count when eviction>threshold.
ops-bot: Handoff: @mike chan, @jordan lee -> night-ops. next-oncall: @alex (cc: oncall-schedule). :thumbsup:
billing-team-bot: Confirmed: notifications canceled, provisional flags rolled back for 39/42 accounts; 3 accounts under manual review due to edge cases. No invoices issued.
priya shah: closing: pager -> monitoring. last update at 07:40 UTC. I'll file postmortem and assign owners for follow-ups (kvcache fix, billing safeguards, alerts). Thanks everyone. :heart:
